context: Mei and Daichi reflect on life with three children.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ダイチ、三人、本当、にぎやか、毎日。
lines.en: Daichi — three of us, really is lively every single day.
lines.style: Warm, gentle opening with a soft smile audible. Reflective, tender tone. Slow pace, lingers on 'every day' like savoring the fact of it. Quiet gratitude beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Really is — it's the best, you know.
lines.style: Kansai warmth and brightness. Genuine appreciation coloring each word. Regional lilt lands on 'best' with unselfconscious joy. Soft real warmth, no performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Slow, philosophical opening. Each word weighted and deliberate. Tender, almost vulnerable — like the truth of it still moves her. Soft trailing-off that contains deep feeling.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Kansai warmth and easy brightness. Affection without self-consciousness. Regional swing audible on the open vowel. Genuine, gentle, no irony.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Every day — grateful, really, all the time.
lines.style: Slow, meditative pace. Quiet, sustained warmth. The gratitude is genuine and runs deep. Gentle emphasis on 'all the time' with soft trailing-off, like an ongoing prayer.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 本当、頑張ってる、メイ、本当に。
lines.en: You're really working so hard, Mei — truly.
lines.style: Kansai warmth and sincerity. Direct, but tender underneath. Firm acknowledgment, not flattery. Regional cadence carries recognition and admiration equally.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ダイチも、本当、頑張ってる。
lines.style: Matching his sincerity with equal warmth. Gentle and steady. Small pause after his name, honoring what she's just heard. Quiet strength underneath.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 一緒に、ずっと、本当に、幸せ。
lines.en: Being together like this — all this time, really happy.
lines.style: Kansai warmth with deep contentment. The regional lilt carries promise and gratitude simultaneously. Slow, savoring each word. Soft, genuine joy without brightness — more depth than spark.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: You're someone precious to me, truly.
lines.style: Tender, vulnerable opening. Slow, deliberate delivery. Each word carries emotional weight. The vulnerability is not hesitant — it's confident and quiet. Soft trailing-off that contains the depth of feeling.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Kansai warmth meeting her vulnerability halfway. Simple, unadorned sincerity. No elaboration needed. Regional cadence makes it both gentle and unshakeable.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Having family close like this — it makes me happy.
lines.style: Warm, appreciative tone with gentle wonder. Slow pace. The happiness is quiet, settled, not effusive. Soft emphasis on 'close' — the physical and emotional proximity matters. Trailing contentment.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Really — and we'll keep going like this, won't we.
lines.style: Kansai warmth with quiet promise. Not a question, but an affirmation spoken gently. The regional lilt carries both commitment and tenderness. Soft, sure, looking forward without rushing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Grateful — truly, every day, all along.
lines.style: Slow, meditative closing. Sustained warmth throughout. Quiet, deep gratitude. Each phrase lands gently but with weight. The trailing-off contains both presence and peace.
